CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS albuminfo_insert_trigger  AFTER INSERT ON albuminfo  BEGIN  INSERT INTO fts_album(rowid,name,artistname,artistalias,extinfo,time)  VALUES (new.albumid,new.name,new.artistname,new.artistalias,new.extinfo,new.time); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS albuminfo_update_trigger  AFTER UPDATE  ON albuminfo  BEGIN  INSERT INTO fts_album(fts_album,rowid,name,artistname,artistalias,extinfo,time)  VALUES ('delete',old.rowid,old.name,old.artistname,old.artistalias,old.extinfo,old.time);  INSERT INTO fts_album(rowid,name,artistname,artistalias,extinfo,time)  VALUES (new.rowid,new.name,new.artistname,new.artistalias,new.extinfo,new.time);  END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS listinfo_del_trigger  AFTER DELETE ON listinfo  BEGIN  INSERT INTO fts_list(fts_list,rowid,name,userid,username,extinfo,time)  VALUES ('delete',old.rowid,old.name,old.userid,old.username,old.extinfo,old.time);  END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS listinfo_insert_trigger  AFTER INSERT ON listinfo  BEGIN  INSERT INTO fts_list(rowid,name,userid,username,extinfo,time)  VALUES (new.listid,new.name,new.userid,new.username,new.extinfo,new.time); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS listinfo_update_trigger  AFTER UPDATE  ON listinfo  BEGIN  INSERT INTO fts_list(fts_list,rowid,name,userid,username,extinfo,time)  VALUES ('delete',old.rowid,old.name,old.userid,old.username,old.extinfo,old.time);  INSERT INTO fts_list(rowid,name,userid,username,extinfo,time)  VALUES (new.rowid,new.name,new.userid,new.username,new.extinfo,new.time);  END;
